scheme_name: "Grant to Subsidy for Raw Materials Procurement" Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme
description:
The "Grant to Subsidy for Raw Materials Procurement" is a significant component of the "Development of Coir" scheme initiated by the Government of India.

The scheme was launched in 2015 as part of the broader initiative to promote the coir industry in India.

The primary objective of this component is to provide financial assistance to coir producers for the procurement of raw materials.

This financial assistance aims to enhance the production capacity of the coir industry.

The scheme targets the enhancement of the quality and quantity of coir products manufactured in India.

The government aims to increase the production of coir products by 20 percent annually through this initiative.

The scheme also seeks to promote sustainable practices in the coir industry.

The financial assistance provided under this component is up to 50 percent of the cost of raw materials.

The maximum financial assistance that can be availed is capped at INR 1 lakh per beneficiary.

This financial support is aimed at small-scale coir producers and cooperatives.

Eligibility for this scheme is primarily focused on individuals and entities involved in coir production.

Beneficiaries must be registered as coir producers with the Coir Board of India.

The age limit for individual applicants is set at a minimum of 18 years.

There are no specific educational qualifications required to apply for this scheme.

However, applicants must demonstrate their involvement in coir production activities.

The application process for the "Grant to Subsidy for Raw Materials Procurement" is straightforward.

Interested beneficiaries must fill out the application form available on the Coir Board's official website.

The application form requires details such as the applicant's name, address, and registration number with the Coir Board.

Applicants must also provide information regarding the type and quantity of raw materials needed.

Additionally, a detailed project report outlining the intended use of the raw materials must be submitted.

Required documents include proof of identity, proof of address, and the registration certificate from the Coir Board.

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the designated authorities at the Coir Board.

The review process typically takes about 30 days from the date of application submission.

If approved, the financial assistance is disbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account.

The disbursement of funds occurs on a quarterly basis.

The Coir Board conducts periodic reviews to ensure that the funds are utilized effectively.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Coir Board of India.

The Coir Board operates under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises.

The headquarters of the Coir Board is located in Kochi, Kerala.

For further assistance, beneficiaries can contact the Coir Board at their official contact number: +91-484-237-0000.

The Coir Board also provides support through regional offices across various states.

The scheme has seen a significant uptake since its launch.

As of 2023, over 10,000 beneficiaries have availed of the financial assistance under this component.

The total amount disbursed under this scheme has exceeded INR 50 crores.

The government has also introduced training programs to enhance the skills of coir producers.

These training programs are aimed at improving the quality of coir products.

The training sessions cover various aspects of coir production and processing.

The Coir Board also collaborates with various state governments to promote the scheme.

State-level workshops are conducted to raise awareness about the benefits of the scheme.

The scheme has contributed to the economic empowerment of many rural households.

It has also played a crucial role in promoting women entrepreneurship in the coir sector.

The coir industry is a significant source of employment in coastal areas of India.

The government aims to create more job opportunities through this scheme.

The "Grant to Subsidy for Raw Materials Procurement" component has been instrumental in reducing the cost of production for coir manufacturers.

This financial support helps small producers compete with larger manufacturers.

The scheme also encourages innovation in the coir industry.

Beneficiaries are motivated to explore new product lines and markets.

The government has set a target to increase the export of coir products by 25 percent in the next five years.

This component of the scheme is crucial for achieving that target.

The Coir Board regularly updates its guidelines to ensure the scheme remains relevant.

The scheme is part of a larger vision to promote the "Make in India" initiative.

The government is committed to enhancing the overall competitiveness of the coir sector.

The scheme aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals by promoting sustainable practices.

The coir industry is known for its eco-friendly products.

This initiative supports the government's efforts to promote green products.

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of quality control in coir production.

Beneficiaries are encouraged to adhere to quality standards set by the Coir Board.

The government monitors the impact of the scheme through various performance indicators.

Regular feedback is collected from beneficiaries to improve the scheme.

The Coir Board aims to create a robust support system for coir producers.

The "Grant to Subsidy for Raw Materials Procurement" is a vital part of this support system.

In conclusion, this component of the "Development of Coir" scheme plays a crucial role in supporting the coir industry in India.

It provides essential financial assistance to enhance production capacity and promote sustainable practices.

The scheme has a significant impact on the livelihoods of coir producers across the country.
